_about: The ground shadow disc under a flying hunter (Xivvy; render/scene.rs hover_shadow). The disc is radius_m wide and alpha dark with her feet on the floor; both shrink as she rises (gimmicks/xivvy.rs lift), the radius to min_radius_fraction of itself and the alpha to nothing at fade_height_m. segments: the disc's edge points. lift_m: how far the disc lies over the floor.
